soundness_flags.label: Definition def:c2-class and Proposition 2
soundness_flags.one_line: The Bernoulli outcome subclass is not guaranteed to satisfy the declared envelope because B is only constrained to be positive; impose B≥1 or rescale the Bernoulli support to [-B,B].

soundness_flags.label: Definition def:branchwise-intervals and Theorem 3
soundness_flags.one_line: The Gaussian interval uses σHat, but the core supplies no construction or consistency requirement for σHat, so the stated coverage cannot be a property of the specified procedure.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 (thm:ambient-gaussian-efficiency)
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem quantifies over P∈PRV and claims feasible ψHat attainment, but its only replacement theorem is restricted to PCtwo; restrict attainment to PCtwo or state an oracle-only PRV bound.
